title: SequentialComprehensionProbeResult
description: Standard output schema for sequential comprehension and first-dependency audit probe in medical education QA.

case_id.description: Echo of the input case or checkpoint identifier.

verdict.description: Audit judgment for the current prefix checkpoint based strictly on provided material.

dependencies.description: Granular atomic prerequisite dependencies evaluated at this focus point. Can be empty if no distinct dependencies are invoked.

fact.description: Description of the atomic prerequisite fact, concept, or patient observation.

use_quote.description: Exact verbatim quote where this fact is first relied upon or presumed known.

status.description: Epistemic status of the dependency at its earliest point of reliance.

source_chunk_id.description: Identifier of the prefix chunk establishing this fact, or null if missing or derived without a dedicated prior chunk.

source_quote.description: Exact continuous verbatim quote establishing the fact, or null if missing.

reason.description: Detailed rationale explaining why this status was assigned, based strictly on the provided prefix.

learner_question.description: Natural cognitive confusion question that a novice learner would raise if this dependency is missing or unclear; null if established, introduced, or derived.

teach_back.description: Plain-language novice retelling of who does what to whom and why the next step occurs, preserving essential terms without expert compensatory additions.

negative_control.description: Evaluation for negative control tasks. Must be populated if task_kind is negative_control, otherwise null.

answerable_from_material.description: Whether the target question can be legitimately answered solely using the provided prefix material.

answer.description: Answer derived strictly from the text, or null if unanswerable from the material.

source_quote.description: Exact continuous quote supporting the answer, or null if unanswerable from the material.

required_edits.description: List of concrete, necessary modifications required to resolve genuine epistemic gaps blocking comprehension. Empty if verdict is pass.

optional_notes.description: Non-blocking stylistic observations, instructional pacing notes, or minor phrasing suggestions that do not impede comprehension.

limits.description: Explicit epistemological boundary declarations regarding prefix cutoff, evidence limitations, unrendered visual states, or perspective limits.
